research_question: Can separating travel and final-heading alignment prevent observed phase chatter without relaxing pose or contact constraints?
research_hypothesis: Phase hysteresis can remove a controller defect. After sharing that repair across controls, geometry-aware route selection may still improve physical efficiency; that incremental claim requires new measurements.

budget_amendment: One optimizer update from the interrupted controller-feasibility probe remains charged and unpromoted. The new comparison may perform at most fifteen more, preserving the original sixteen-update total ceiling. All used training layouts and unlabelled failures are retained.
unlabelled_training_rule: Retain every physically failed candidate set. If all three fail, record no supervised label and continue to the next pre-generated training layout without an optimizer update. Save and evaluate the actual endpoint if bounded data is exhausted before fifteen updates.
